subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
8. 
Considering the facts given in the case regarding the relationship between the 
outstanding balance in the CC account and the drawing power determined by the branch, 
how should the auditor evaluate the status of the account as on the reporting date? 
(a)  
The account is regular since the sanctioned limit has not been exceeded. 
(b)  
The account should be treated as out of order since the outstanding balance has 
remained continuously in excess of the drawing power. 
6 
(c)  
The account is regular because the borrower had submitted stock statements 
earlier during the year. 
(d)  
The account cannot be evaluated until audited financial statements are finalized.
